summary: Adams County, ID log cabin on Payette NF, 13 miles SSW of Riggins; built 1932 or 1933; sources disagree on fate (1966, 1983 standing, 1999 burned); site today undescribed.

facts.design: Log cabin on the north end of a minor point
facts.status_note: Sources disagree on the fate: still standing in 1983 per firelookout.com, disposed of by burning in 1966 per Forest Lookouts, burned in 1999 per Idaho Fire Lookouts; no source describes the site now

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts gives 1932 for the log structure; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both give 1933. The story uses 1933 and mentions the 1932 date.

firelookout.com says it was still standing in 1983; Forest Lookouts says it was disposed of by burning in 1966; Idaho Fire Lookouts says it burned in 1999. The story reports all three and does not choose one. The Forest Fire Lookout Association list says only gone.

sources.title: Lockwood Point Lookout – Idaho Fire Lookouts

notes_for_editor: Gone per the FFLA list, but the fate conflicts across three sources (standing 1983, disposed of by burning 1966, burned 1999) and the story reports the disagreement without choosing. Build year is 1933 in two sources and 1932 in Forest Lookouts. A Payette National Forest Facebook post seen only in a search snippet dates construction to 1931 and says the lookout was about 13 miles south of Riggins; the fetch returned a login wall, so it is not cited and needs a look by a reviewer with access. No source describes the site now or public access, so access is omitted. Reads: three lookout pages and the FFLA list, plus one WebSearch; the Payette post was not readable.
